measurement: MCP initialize followed by tools/list against createMcpServer() from the pinned commit

serialization.payload: JSON.stringify(stablySorted(tools)) without whitespace or trailing newline

source.method: MCP initialize then tools/list; server source Git blob verified against pinned commit before capture

initialize.instructions: Start with godot_doctor. After mutations, save and call godot_project_check. For interactive verification, launch the scene, observe structured state, capture screenshots only as visual evidence, inject bounded input, wait and assert the expected state, then always call godot_run_stop. Do not claim success from a screenshot alone.

tools.name: godot_doctor
tools.title: Diagnose Godot development environment
tools.description: Checks Node.js, local configuration, Godot, optional DeepSeek Harness, and loopback TCP readiness.

tools.name: godot_projects_find
tools.title: Find Godot projects
tools.description: Searches a bounded directory tree for project.godot files and returns stable project metadata.

tools.name: godot_project_inspect
tools.title: Inspect a Godot project
tools.description: Reads project.godot and returns the project name, main scene, renderer, and enabled plugins.

tools.name: godot_project_check
tools.title: Import and validate a Godot project
tools.description: Starts the configured Godot editor in headless mode, imports the project, and returns bounded diagnostics.

tools.name: godot_file_read
tools.title: Read a Godot project text file
tools.description: Reads a bounded UTF-8 Godot project file without following symlinks. Returns SHA-256 for conflict-safe writes.

tools.name: godot_file_write
tools.title: Safely write a Godot project text file
tools.description: Atomically creates or updates an allowlisted UTF-8 project file. Pass expectedSha256 from godot_file_read (or null to require creation) to prevent lost updates.

tools.name: godot_addon_install
tools.title: Install the Godot Agent Runtime addon
tools.description: Copies the versioned EditorPlugin into the project and enables it while preserving existing enabled plugins.

tools.name: godot_scene_run
tools.title: Run a Godot scene headlessly
tools.description: Runs the main or specified scene for a bounded number of frames and returns console output and diagnostics.

tools.name: godot_scene_launch
tools.title: Launch a visible Godot scene
tools.description: Starts the main or specified scene in a persistent visible window and returns a runId for status and stop operations.

tools.name: godot_run_status
tools.title: Read a visible Godot run
tools.description: Returns persistent process state plus bounded stdout, stderr, and diagnostics for a runId.

tools.name: godot_run_stop
tools.title: Stop a visible Godot run
tools.description: Requests a token-authenticated stop for a runId and waits for a terminal state. Repeated calls are safe.

tools.name: godot_runtime_status
tools.title: Inspect the runtime bridge
tools.description: Authenticates to a managed run and returns its negotiated runtime capabilities and active scene.

tools.name: godot_runtime_screenshot
tools.title: Capture the running game
tools.description: Captures the root viewport to a PNG under the run-specific evidence directory and returns path, dimensions, size, and SHA-256.

tools.name: godot_runtime_ui_find
tools.title: Find visible runtime UI
tools.description: Returns bounded Control nodes with stable paths, types, text, visibility, disabled state, and global rectangles.

tools.name: godot_runtime_scene_tree
tools.title: Read the runtime scene tree
tools.description: Returns the current running scene as a depth- and node-bounded structural tree without exposing the bridge node.

tools.name: godot_runtime_node_get
tools.title: Read a runtime node
tools.description: Reads identity and up to 100 declared properties from one running node; no methods or arbitrary code can be invoked.

tools.name: godot_runtime_observe
tools.title: Observe gameplay-focused runtime state
tools.description: Returns bounded multi-node snapshots with transforms, velocity, animation, collision state, groups, metadata, and requested extra properties.

tools.name: godot_runtime_simulate_physics
tools.title: Simulate physics in an isolated world
tools.description: Duplicates the current scene into private 2D/3D worlds, advances 1-120 physics frames with optional InputMap action, samples one node, and restores the live tree pause state.

tools.name: godot_runtime_3d_project
tools.title: Project a 3D point into the game viewport
tools.description: Uses an active or explicitly selected Camera3D to map a Node3D or world position to screenshot pixel coordinates, including visibility and depth.

tools.name: godot_runtime_3d_raycast
tools.title: Raycast from a game viewport pixel
tools.description: Projects a screenshot pixel through Camera3D and performs a bounded physics ray query, returning the hit collider path, position, and normal.

tools.name: godot_runtime_input
tools.title: Inject bounded runtime input
tools.description: Clicks a Control path or coordinates, pulses an InputMap action, or sends a numeric keycode. Hold duration is capped at 2 seconds.

tools.name: godot_runtime_input_sequence
tools.title: Inject a bounded runtime input sequence
tools.description: Runs 1-32 validated click/action/key steps in order with bounded holds and delays totaling at most 5 seconds.

tools.name: godot_runtime_assert
tools.title: Assert structured runtime state
tools.description: Evaluates a bounded UI-existence or node-property predicate and returns passed, expected, actual, and structured evidence.

tools.name: godot_runtime_wait
tools.title: Wait for structured runtime state
tools.description: Polls a bounded UI or property predicate on process frames until it passes or the wait timeout expires, returning the last structured observation.

tools.name: godot_runtime_control
tools.title: Pause, resume, or step the runtime
tools.description: Pauses/resumes the SceneTree or advances 1-120 process frames while paused. Step requires an explicit prior pause.

tools.name: godot_editor_launch
tools.title: Launch a managed Godot editor
tools.description: Starts an enabled EditorPlugin in a visible managed editor and returns a runId shared by editor status, scene-tree, screenshot, and stop tools.

tools.name: godot_editor_status
tools.title: Inspect the EditorPlugin bridge
tools.description: Authenticates to a managed editor and reports the open scene and read-only editor capabilities.

tools.name: godot_editor_scene_tree
tools.title: Read the edited scene tree
tools.description: Returns the currently edited scene as a bounded-depth structural tree of paths, names, types, and owners.

tools.name: godot_editor_node_get
tools.title: Read an edited scene node
tools.description: Reads one edited-scene node and up to 100 named properties. Godot Variants use tagged JSON objects such as {$type:'Vector2',x,y}.

tools.name: godot_editor_selection_get
tools.title: Read the editor selection
tools.description: Returns selected edited-scene node paths and the focused node path.

tools.name: godot_editor_selection_set
tools.title: Select and focus edited-scene nodes
tools.description: Replaces the editor selection with up to 100 scene nodes and optionally focuses the first node in the Inspector.

tools.name: godot_editor_node_create
tools.title: Create an edited scene node
tools.description: Creates an instantiable Godot Node under parentPath, sets owner to the edited root, applies validated properties, and records one native Undo/Redo action.

tools.name: godot_editor_scene_instantiate
tools.title: Instantiate a PackedScene
tools.description: Loads a project-local .tscn and adds an editable scene instance below a parent as one native Undo/Redo action.

tools.name: godot_editor_scene_create_inherited
tools.title: Create an inherited PackedScene
tools.description: Uses Godot PackedScene and SceneState APIs to create a project-local inherited .tscn with optional root overrides; target file creation is not Undo/Redo-backed.

tools.name: godot_editor_instance_get
tools.title: Read PackedScene instance editability
tools.description: Reports the source scene and editable-children state of an instantiated PackedScene root.

tools.name: godot_editor_instance_set_editable
tools.title: Set PackedScene editable children
tools.description: Enables or disables editable children through Node.set_editable_instance as one native Godot Undo/Redo action.

tools.name: godot_editor_node_update
tools.title: Update an edited scene node
tools.description: Renames a node and/or applies validated Godot properties as one native Undo/Redo action. Structural owner and scene path properties are rejected.

tools.name: godot_editor_node_delete
tools.title: Delete an edited scene node
tools.description: Removes a non-root node while retaining it for native Undo/Redo restoration.

tools.name: godot_editor_node_move
tools.title: Move an edited scene node
tools.description: Reparents and/or reorders a non-root node as one native Undo/Redo action, rejecting cycles and name conflicts.

tools.name: godot_editor_resource_create
tools.title: Create an inline Godot resource
tools.description: Creates a validated Resource, applies tagged Variant properties, and assigns it to one edited-scene node property as a native Undo/Redo action.

tools.name: godot_editor_resource_get
tools.title: Read a Godot resource
tools.description: Reads up to 100 declared properties from the Resource stored in one edited-scene node property.

tools.name: godot_editor_resource_update
tools.title: Update a Godot resource
tools.description: Applies validated Resource subproperties as one native Godot Undo/Redo action; it does not invoke methods or save an external file.

tools.name: godot_editor_resource_save
tools.title: Save an external Godot resource
tools.description: Saves a node's Resource property as a project-local .tres. Overwrite is rejected by default; the filesystem side effect is not undoable.

tools.name: godot_editor_resource_focus
tools.title: Focus a project resource
tools.description: Selects a validated project-local resource in the FileSystem dock and opens it through EditorInterface.

tools.name: godot_editor_signal_connect
tools.title: Connect an edited scene signal
tools.description: Creates a persistent signal-to-method connection between edited-scene nodes as one native Undo/Redo action.

tools.name: godot_editor_scene_save
tools.title: Save the edited scene
tools.description: Saves the active edited scene through EditorInterface and returns the res:// path and Godot error code.

tools.name: godot_editor_undo
tools.title: Undo an edited scene action
tools.description: Undoes the latest action in the active scene's native Godot Undo/Redo history.

tools.name: godot_editor_redo
tools.title: Redo an edited scene action
tools.description: Redoes the next action in the active scene's native Godot Undo/Redo history.

tools.name: godot_editor_screenshot
tools.title: Capture an editor 2D or 3D viewport
tools.description: Captures the managed editor's 2D viewport or one of four 3D viewports and returns active 3D editor camera metadata with the PNG evidence.
